header.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production website header asset, not a mockup. Use the original miniature village image as style reference. Recompose as a wide panoramic 2.4:1 banner, requested canvas 1920 x 800. Maintain natural architecture proportions, do not stretch or flatten houses. Beautiful handcrafted ceramic Christmas village at blue hour, warm red cinema centered, flanking cottages, clocktower, snowy little street, garlands, old gas lamps, collectible macro photograph. Large physical marquee lettering reads exactly "Merry Watch" in dark burgundy on illuminated cream with brass edging. Sign prominent and naturally part of cinema architecture, readable on a phone with no overlay. No other text, no device, no blank label.

cookieStylePrompt: Use case: product-mockup. Reference image is STYLE ONLY: the user-approved simple bowling-ball sugar cookie. Create ONE new realistically bakeable cutout sugar cookie of the specified motif. Square overhead photograph, fully visible cookie centered taking about 80–85% of image, same warm ivory background and soft natural shadow as reference. A real golden-baked sugar cookie edge, FLAT SMOOTH FLOODED ROYAL ICING, a few slightly raised piped lines, tiny handmade imperfections. BOLD BASIC HIGH-CONTRAST design legible at 100 pixels. An experienced home cookie decorator must actually be able to make it using a shaped cutter and about 3–4 icing colors. One large motif only with a small festive accent. No people, faces, portraits, cartoon characters, illustration panels, landscape scenes, clutter, filigree, dragees, elaborate sculptures, printed photographic icing, text or logos. Do not copy the reference bowling-ball shape; use the specified object's silhouette. No extra cookies or background props. Product photograph rather than a digital icon.

One tan COWBOY BOOT cutout cookie with a red cuff, one white piped stitching curve, and a tiny green holly leaf with two red berries at the ankle. No cowboy, horse or scene. Thick sturdy silhouette and very simple icing.

One cutout cookie shaped as a STACK OF TWO CLOSED BOOKS. Lower book evergreen, upper book winter blue, broad cream page blocks, one red ribbon across the two books. Two bold stacked rectangles, no tiny lettering, bookshop scene or people.

One RED PICKUP TRUCK WITH A CHRISTMAS TREE cutout cookie as a single joined silhouette. A boxy red side-view truck, one cream window, two big black circular wheels, one simple large green triangle tree in its bed. Only red, green, white and black icing. No scenery, extra parcels or fine engine details.

One turquoise FISH cutout cookie with a broad simple fish silhouette, three thick white curved scale marks and one small red bow at its tail. One tiny black eye is fine, no cartoon human expression. Bold edible fish symbol for the Feast of the Seven Fishes, not a meal scene.

One cream rectangular LETTER ENVELOPE cookie. Two bold red diagonal lines form the envelope flap. One large green Christmas-tree-shaped stamp in its top right corner and a red heart seal in the middle. No words, address or Santa figure. Simple letter-to-Santa motif.

One GOLD SKELETON KEY cutout cookie with a large round head, thick shaft and two chunky teeth. Cream filled center of the round head rather than a fragile hole. Small red bow around shaft. Simple bold secret-scavenger-hunt key, no scene or lettering.

One simple FAIRYTALE CASTLE cutout cookie: just three chunky pink towers, three winter-blue triangular roofs, a broad cream arched door and white snow caps. A tiny red bow at the base. A generic vacation-castle symbol, no logos, branded characters, people, fireworks or landscape. Maximum five icing colors, bold basic blocks.

One rounded arch-shaped dark blue cookie with a LARGE SIMPLE GOLD HANUKKAH MENORAH icon: nine connected upright branches, the middle candle taller, nine little white/gold flame drops, two tiny white star dots. Flat piped icing, no complex scene, Christmas holly, people or words. Bold respectful blue-and-gold Hanukkah design.

One cranberry-red SUITCASE cutout cookie with a broad cream handle, two cream straps, a single small green luggage tag and a tiny white snowy top edge. Bold travel-home-for-Christmas icon. No traveler, vehicles or scene.

One thick six-pointed SNOWFLAKE cutout cookie. Pale winter-blue flooded base, bold raised white piped central branches with just two short lines off each arm. No lace filigree, pearls or extra motifs. Strong simple snowflake, practically decorateable by hand.

One chunky HOURGLASS cutout cookie with a dark green frame, cream glass interior and two simple gold triangular sand shapes. One small red bow on its broad top bar. No castle, people or time-travel scene. A single readable hourglass icon.

One RED ADMISSION TICKET cookie with two broad notched ends, a big gold star in its center, a few bold white perforation dots along each end and two tiny green holly leaves in a corner. No words, logo, people or event scene. One simple festive ticket.

One single ANGEL WING cutout cookie. Cream-white flooded wing with three broad feather lobes and just three thick gold piped feather lines. One small cranberry-red bow at its base. No angel face, human body, halo character or scene. Very simple soft feather silhouette.

One GOLD CHRISTMAS BELL cutout cookie with a broad gold dome, cream lower rim, small round gold clapper and a red bow at top. One small black musical note piped on the bell ties it to Christmas choirs. No cathedral, people or scene.

One SNOW GLOBE cutout cookie with a pale blue round dome, simple red trapezoid base, one big cream heart centered inside and three white snow dots. No miniature village, houses, people or scenery inside the globe. Bold proposal-town snow globe symbol.

One mint-green CAMPER VAN cutout cookie in side view. Simple rounded van silhouette, two large cream windows, two big black wheel circles and one small red bow on its door. No people, scenery or intricate vehicle details. Four icing colors, strong easy-to-read travel icon.

One round BLACK VINYL RECORD cookie with three bold cream concentric groove lines, a large red heart-shaped center label and two tiny green holly leaves at lower edge. No tiny writing, singer or museum scene. Simple music-and-romance icon.

One broad WHITE DOG BONE cutout cookie with two rounded ends and a small bright red bow around its center, plus two tiny green holly leaves. No dog face, paw print, person or scene. Bold classic bone silhouette.

One GOLD WEDDING RING cutout cookie with a chunky circular band and a big cream diamond silhouette on top. The ring center remains cream icing on solid cookie rather than a fragile hollow hole. One tiny red bow at the lower edge. Simple bold ring icon, no couple or wedding scene.

One chunky dark green OVEN MITT cutout cookie with one broad cream cuff and a big red heart in the middle. Two short white icing quilting lines only. A simple baking-mitt symbol, no hands, bakers, kitchen or elaborate cake.

One MAGIC WAND cutout cookie as a single thick connected shape: short chocolate-brown wand shaft with a large gold five-pointed star tip and one tiny red icing bow near the handle. Cream piped highlight on star. No branded symbols, people, wizard faces or scene.

One LARGE GREEN CHRISTMAS LIGHT BULB cutout cookie. Broad teardrop bulb, short gray screw cap with just two white horizontal lines, one white curved shine mark and a tiny red bow beside the cap. No houses, people, writing or light-display scene. Strong simple festive bulb silhouette.
